text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This year's summer camp has begun. Since this isn't the first time we've had camp, Yukino Bijin appears more familiar with what to do.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've already dropped off my luggage, so let's get straight t'training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup at the top of my game!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've gotta do everyth'n I can t'make sure I'm ready!
choice_data_list: Okay, then! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it! So what should we—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …There's def'nitely someth'n going on with her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've caught Gold City looking pensive and sighing up a storm a few times since the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So many people are already talking about her. And not just about her running, but her appearance too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There's no way all this talk isn't affecting her…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there's someth'n weigh'n on her mind?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urgh… But even if there is, it's not like there's anyth'n I could do for City…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I mean, City's amaz'n, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: She's fierce, conf'dent, coolheaded… She's just perfect. I wouldn't dare go stick'n my nose in her business.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back when we were rac'n for the first time, she seemed like the city girl… but you're right, no one's perfect.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: You should talk to her if you get the chance.
You should talk to her if you get the chance.
